scope: Bounded control-tool source/method review only. No formal source, checker gate, mathematical review scope or pending inspection count is changed.

finding.initial_status: Concrete read-only method issue reported to coordinator before first use.
finding.initial_location: Initial helper lines26-27 and its status callers.
finding.issue: Ordinary git status may refresh/write the index as an optional operation, contrary to this helper being read-only. No such recorder execution or write is claimed to have occurred.
finding.required_correction: Use Git global --no-optional-locks for all metadata reads, or the equivalent GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0.
finding.current_status: Fixed before first use; independently confirmed in119-line source4df281f3.

bytecode_boundary: sys.dont_write_bytecode=True precedes project-script imports in both the first observed and corrected versions. It was already present in the117-line observation; no new bytecode correction is invented in the two-line source delta.

static_method_assessment.candidate_and_clean_state: The supplied full candidate is checked against HEAD and project status before capture; all Git calls now disable optional locks. This is a scoped observation, not an atomic repository transaction or a substitute for immutable-run ownership.
static_method_assessment.configuration: All ten recorded pin/checker/configuration inputs are fingerprinted and checked against the retained reference.
static_method_assessment.dependencies: The manifest drives nine dependency source lookups in the intended projects; each HEAD must equal its manifest revision and status must be clean. Dependency object/cache authenticity is not certified by this.
static_method_assessment.runtime: All twelve already-qualified component fingerprints are re-read and compared with the retained expected digests; the reference/profile qualification and actual producer command remain separate evidence.
static_method_assessment.project_parser_import: The pinned checker exposes the pure string/comment remover. Its top-level code and the imported lake_integrity module have imports/constants/function definitions with the checker main guarded by __name__; importing them does not call a build or integrity guard. Bytecode writing is disabled.
static_method_assessment.local_closure: The exact prepared program imports drive local-source traversal; existing local files receive byte hashes and candidate Git blob identifiers, external imports are listed, and each local root requires an existing .olean. The recorded working-source hashes still must be matched to immutable source inputs by the acceptance/reuse review; a blob identifier annotation alone is not a proof of byte equality.
static_method_assessment.objects_and_traces: For each local module, the helper fingerprints the existing .olean, .olean.hash, .olean.private, .olean.server and .trace paths. It does not execute Lake, certify that these objects are authentic/correct/fresh, or verify external package objects. Qualified build/integrity evidence remains separately mandatory.
static_method_assessment.program: The helper records the actual program path, byte count/hash and fully qualified #check names. Program contents are preserved separately in the existing prepared artifact; this JSON records their identity, not a second literal source copy.
static_method_assessment.comparison: A new observation cannot overwrite an existing output. A supplied previous identity is compared exactly; on difference the new record is preserved and the process exits unsuccessfully. Matching snapshots do not themselves establish compiler execution, actual output or acceptance.
static_method_assessment.output_location: Intended invocation must choose a new control/provenance output outside the project/source/build trees; the tool necessarily writes that requested observation.

pure_text_analysis.method: Without invoking the recorder or importing/executing the checker module, isolated the already-read pure executable_source string function and compared its regex results against an independent nested-comment/string parser over immutable Git source blobs and the exact prepared programs. No compiler or build outputs were read or changed.

format_scope: Assessment covers these exact prepared programs and current local import syntax. The regex is not a general Lean parser: it expects the reviewed import/check command layout, and the raw #check scan would not independently distinguish commands inside block comments. Current programs contain no such false matches; cleaned and raw command lists both exactly match the complete145/814 inventories. Any future format change needs a bounded parser/name reconciliation, not automatic reliance on a count.
required_use_boundary: Retain this tool hash/reference/method record with the actual observation and producer run provenance.

Run pre/post observations only under the same immutable-candidate and exclusive-output discipline as the actual qualified statement command; do not run against a project owned by a concurrent builder.
Preserve distinct pre/post observation files, the actual executed program bytes and all actual outer/native start/terminal/log artifacts.
Require successful actual statement inspection and complete output assessment; do not credit prepared programs, input snapshots or hashes as printed types.
Retain separate qualified build/integrity evidence and all original full candidate/audit/review/immediate-verification gates.
